El modo local gratuito guarda el histori: Free local mode saves strength and cardio history, preferences and optional health data in this browser's storage. It requires no account and does not send these records to a server. Clearing site data deletes this copy; another browser or device does not receive it automatically.
Podés descargar una copia desde Ajustes: You can download a copy from Settings and import a file of your choice. Importing local history replaces the local copy after your confirmation: export first to keep both versions. Downloaded files may contain health data; choose where to save them and whom to share them with.
Las series de un entrenamiento en curso: Sets in an ongoing workout and unsaved forms stay in memory. Reloading or closing the tab before saving discards these drafts. If the browser cannot save, the app shows an error; export your data before closing.
Mi salud es opcional. Podés registrar pe: My health is optional. You can record your physical profile, body measurements, sleep, activity, heart rate, meals, supplements and goals. In local mode they stay on this device. They are not sent to visit analytics or AI services.
La importación de salud acepta el format: Health import accepts the normalized format shown in My health, with a preview before importing. It keeps the source declared in the file without verifying its authenticity. This version does not automatically connect to Google Health, Samsung Health or Health Connect.
Las tendencias describen tus registros y: Trends describe your records and goals. Watch estimates are not clinical measurements. The app does not diagnose, prescribe supplements or calculate a mandatory calorie deficit.
Esta demo no inicializa cuentas, pagos,: This demo does not initialize accounts, payments, cloud integrations or analytics. It does not use session cookies or request permission to access a watch. All local features remain available without a subscription.
Los archivos de la aplicación, el modelo: The app files, anatomy model and previews are served from the same site. Typography uses fonts available on your device. The demo does not download third-party fonts or scripts.
Si abrís esta demo desde un sitio en int: If you open this demo on a website, its server receives the requests needed to deliver these files and network data such as the IP address. The operator's identity, providers and retention periods depend on the site you chose; this product copy does not assume a specific operator or host.
La infraestructura de medición recibe da: The analytics infrastructure receives network data, including the IP address and browser type. Declining does not limit the app. Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control are respected. You can withdraw permission from Privacy preferences; a request already received cannot be withdrawn retroactively.
La elección vence a los seis meses o ant: Your choice expires after six months, or earlier if the policy version changes. This page does not generate analytics visits.
La infraestructura puede procesar solici: The infrastructure may process requests, IP addresses and logs to deliver and protect the website, independently of analytics.
Las fuentes de ejercicios y las licencia: Exercise sources and licenses link to external sites. Opening a link is subject to that site's policy; Klisteni does not attach your personal records to the link. Data that exists only in your browser is managed from that device.
